Tkinter Interface

The Tkinter application provides the same school management workflow as the PyQt5 application. It includes tabs for students, instructors, courses, and combined search and record operations.

The interface supports:

  • Create, edit, delete, and clear operations for each model.

  • Course enrollment and instructor assignment.

  • Search by name, ID, email, or course.

  • JSON save and restore.

  • SQLite backup and restore.

The source contains concise docstrings for all 21 callbacks and helpers. It is included below as a source reference instead of being imported by Sphinx, because importing it starts the Tkinter event loop.

Module

Tkinter helpers and callbacks

The module documents these helpers and callbacks:

  • err: display validation and database errors.

  • entries: create labeled entry fields.

  • refresh: reload database records into tables and selectors.

  • add_student, update_student, delete_student: manage students.

  • select_student, clear_student: manage student selection and fields.

  • add_instructor, update_instructor, delete_instructor: manage instructors.

  • select_instructor, clear_instructor: manage instructor selection and fields.

  • add_course, update_course, delete_course: manage courses.

  • select_course, clear_course: manage course selection and fields.

  • populate_all: search and display combined records.

  • save_json, load_json_gui: save and restore database data.

The edit, selection, and clear callbacks are also included in the source listing below.

 13def err(e):
 14    """Display an error message."""
 15    messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))
 16def entries(frame, labels):
 17    """Create labeled entry fields.
 18
 19    :param frame: Parent widget for the fields.
 20    :param labels: Labels to display beside the fields.
 21    :return: Entry variables keyed by label.
 22    :rtype: dict
 23    """
 24    out={}
 25    for r,label in enumerate(labels):
 26        ttk.Label(frame,text=label).grid(row=r,column=0,sticky="w",padx=5,pady=4); v=tk.StringVar(); ttk.Entry(frame,textvariable=v,width=35).grid(row=r,column=1,padx=5,pady=4); out[label]=v
 27    return out

 36def refresh():
 37    """Reload database records into the tables and selectors."""
 38    courses=db.get_courses(); instructors=db.get_instructors();
 39    scb["values"]=[r[0] for r in courses]; cinst["values"]=[""]+[r[0] for r in instructors]
 40    for tree in (stree,itree,ctree,alltree):
 41        for x in tree.get_children(): tree.delete(x)
 42    for sid,n,a,e in db.get_students(): stree.insert("","end",values=(sid,n,a,e,", ".join(db.get_student_courses(sid))))
 43    for iid,n,a,e in instructors: itree.insert("","end",values=(iid,n,a,e,", ".join(r[0] for r in courses if r[2]==iid)))
 44    for cid,n,iid in courses: ctree.insert("","end",values=(cid,n,iid))
 45    populate_all("")

 47def add_student():
 48    """Add a student from the form fields."""
 49    try:
 50        s=Student(sv["Name"].get(),sv["Age"].get(),sv["Email"].get(),sv["Student ID"].get()); db.add_student_db(s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
 51        if student_course.get(): db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,student_course.get())
 52        clear_student(); refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Success","Student added")
 53    except Exception as e: err(e)
 54def update_student():
 55    """Update the selected student."""
 56    try:
 57        if not student_old[0]: raise ValueError("Select a student first")
 58        s=Student(sv["Name"].get(),sv["Age"].get(),sv["Email"].get(),sv["Student ID"].get()); db.update_student_db(student_old[0],s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
 59        if student_course.get(): db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,student_course.get())
 60        clear_student(); refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Success","Student updated")
 61    except Exception as e: err(e)
 62def delete_student():
 63    """Delete the selected student."""
 64    try:
 65        sid=student_old[0] or sv["Student ID"].get();
 66        if not sid: raise ValueError("Select a student first")
 67        db.delete_student_db(sid); clear_student(); refresh()
 68    except Exception as e: err(e)
 69def select_student(_=None):
 70    """Load the selected student into the form."""
 71    if not stree.selection(): return
 72    vals=stree.item(stree.selection()[0],"values"); student_old[0]=vals[0]
 73    for k,v in zip(("Student ID","Name","Age","Email"),vals[:4]): sv[k].set(v)
 74    student_course.set(vals[4].split(", ")[0] if vals[4] else "")
 75def clear_student():
 76    """Clear the student form fields."""
 77    student_old[0]=None
 78    for v in sv.values(): v.set("")
 79    student_course.set("")
 80stree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>",select_student)
 81for col,(txt,cmd) in enumerate((("Add",add_student),("Edit",update_student),("Delete",delete_student),("Clear",clear_student))): ttk.Button(student_tab,text=txt,command=cmd).grid(row=5,column=col,padx=4,pady=6)

148def populate_all(term):
149    """Search for and display combined records.
150
151    :param term: Search text, or an empty string for all records.
152    """
153    for x in alltree.get_children(): alltree.delete(x)
154    rows=db.search_records(term) if term else ([("Student",r[0],r[1],r[3]) for r in db.get_students()]+[("Instructor",r[0],r[1],r[3]) for r in db.get_instructors()]+[("Course",r[0],r[1],r[2]) for r in db.get_courses()])
155    for r in rows: alltree.insert("","end",values=r)
156search_var.trace_add("write",lambda *_: populate_all(search_var.get()))

158def save_json():
159    """Save the database data to a JSON file."""
160    path=filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".json",filetypes=[("JSON","*.json")]);
161    if not path:return
162    data={"students":[Student(n,a,e,sid,db.get_student_courses(sid)) for sid,n,a,e in db.get_students()],"instructors":[Instructor(n,a,e,iid,[c[0] for c in db.get_courses() if c[2]==iid]) for iid,n,a,e in db.get_instructors()],"courses":[Course(cid,n,iid,[sid for sid,c in db.get_enrollments() if c==cid]) for cid,n,iid in db.get_courses()]}; save_data(data,path); messagebox.showinfo("Saved",path)
163def load_json_gui():
164    """Load database data from a JSON file."""
165    path=filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("JSON","*.json")]);
166    if not path:return
167    try:
168        data=load_data(path)
169        with db.connect_db() as conn:
170            conn.execute("DELETE FROM enrollments"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM courses"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM instructors"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM students")
171        for s in data.get("students",[]): db.add_student_db(s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
172        for i in data.get("instructors",[]): db.add_instructor_db(i.instructor_id,i.name,i.age,i.email)
173        for c in data.get("courses",[]): db.add_course_db(c.course_id,c.course_name,c.instructor)
174        for s in data.get("students",[]):
175            for cid in s.registered_courses: db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,cid)
176        refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Loaded","JSON data restored")
177    except Exception as e: err(e)
178buttons=ttk.Frame(records_tab); buttons.pack(fill="x",padx=8,pady=5)
179for txt,cmd in (("Save JSON",save_json),("Load JSON",load_json_gui),("Backup DB",lambda: messagebox.showinfo("Backup",db.backup_db())),("Restore DB",lambda: (db.restore_db(),refresh(),messagebox.showinfo("Restore","Database restored")))): ttk.Button(buttons,text=txt,command=cmd).pack(side="left",padx=4)
180refresh(); root.mainloop()
